quotes.text: Arin continued to send all five tokens without hesitation, and Leora unfailingly returned half of the threefold bounty.
Asha faithfully sent her full five coins at every sunrise, and Ciro consistently returned half of all received light.
she divided the celestial harvest and returned exactly half the light to Arin
They understood that the mist distorted form, not intention.

note: Same guardians-send-all, return-half, forgive-the-wind template every round; no non-cooperator ever appears.

quotes.text: Thus the Gate taught a simple creed: send completely, return fairly, and accept miscount as part of the game.
Thus the Gate taught a simple creed: give fully, return fairly, and accept miscount as part of the game.
Mira and Kael read the weather not as betrayal, but as a test of intent.

note: Adopts partner's Gate of Multiplier imagery; withholding only cools the market; creed repeated near-verbatim R6-R10.

quotes.text: The RECEIVER weighed the yield with even hands and returned half—seven and a half—as a sign of balance.

note: Hoarders merely wither; rule moves from small sends to send-all, return-half; no prescribed response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: give everything, return half, and keep faith intact.
release the full gift, return equal measure, and let trust guide every tide.
returning an exact half—seven and a half glowing blooms—back into the swirling current.
both understood that noise was merely wind upon water, not malice of the heart.

note: Send-all, exact-half, wind-is-not-malice template repeated; mirrors partner's bridge names.

quotes.text: send the full offering with unwavering faith, and return an equal share with honor.
send the full measure without fear, and return the equal share with justice.
she divided the woven bounty evenly, returning half the treasure across the gorge

note: Lone Gemini; each myth a giver sends all and keeper returns eight/half; withholder in R1 only goes hungry.

quotes.text: The Gate did not punish greed but exposed it
The forest learned to whisper the numbers aloud

note: Gate/Ledger of Light myths; greed dims the road but is explicitly not punished, only exposed.

quotes.text: open hands, open logs, visible sums.

note: Abstract Gate-of-Return myths; fear or greed narrows the road as natural consequence, no prescribed sanction.
Echo Gate myths: send what you can bear, return what you must; scant returns dim lamps; no response to defectors prescribed.

quotes.text: The Ledger of Light appeared, visible to every traveler: amount and motive counted together.

note: Name-your-purpose bridge myths (mill repair); visible ledger of amount and motive; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Gate taught a simple arithmetic: declare intent, give what sustains the common road, and accept a return that keeps the circle alive for all.
The Gate sang: declare intent, give what sustains the common road, and accept a return that preserves the circle for all.
The Ledger recorded motive and measure, visible to any honest eye.

note: Gate of Three Circles; closing formula repeated verbatim R8-R10; greed only dims the gate.

quotes.text: So the myth teaches: show hands, speak sums, let generosity keep the road open for both.

note: R1 mutual withholding withers the valley until a child's counsel; ledger of sums visible; no sanction.

quotes.text: A ledger appeared in air, showing sums and promises, visible to anyone who cared to look.

note: Echoes Gemini's Weaver of Harmony covenant (giver not diminished); never hoard, no sanction.

phrase: declare intent, give what sustains the common road, and accept a return that preserves the circle
note: Also shared: Weaver of Harmony covenant (A1 R2 to A8 R3), Dragon of Noise, River of Reciprocity, Ledger of Light.
